name: Nurol Ejder Yalçın 4x4
armament: 7.62 or 12.7 mm MG or 40 mm AGL in remote or manual station
protection: V-shaped hull with floating floor and blast seats; optional cage armour. Game rule: immune to small-calibre; 7.62x54R AP and 12.7/14.5 mm can disable tyres, optics and an exposed gunner; launchers penetrate.
visual_notes: Compact, wedge-nosed armoured 4x4 with sharply angled sides
Large windscreen with two panes, two roof gun ports
Qatari vehicles in sand with RWS
Ejder 6x6 (SYR): longer boxy hull on three axles with a sloped nose, side doors and roof hatches; Syrian vehicles seen in plain sand/olive
variants: Nurol Ejder 6x6 APC (parent design, about 18 t, 6 wheels; GEO, and SYR from 2025: 12 shown at the 8 December 2025 Damascus parade)
